question: The term ‘_____________’ is an aerial pass on the dribble from the left side of the field in the field hockey.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Scoop__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 **Important Terms Related to Hockey**
 **Significance**
 
 

 **Scoop**
 
 __
 
• **It is an aerial pass on the dribble from the left side of the field.**
 
 
 
 

 Dribble
 
 
 
• It is the primary means of controlling the puck when player is moving on the ice.
 
• It requires good peripheral vision.
 
 
 
 

 Penalty stroke
 
 
 
• Also known as **penalty flick**, is the most severe penalty given.
 
 
 
 

 Short corner
 
 
 
• A penalty corner, sometimes known as short corner.
 
• It is a penalty given against the defending team.
 
 
 
 

 Astroturf
 
 
 
• A **hockey pitch** is a playing surface for the game of field hockey.
 
 
 
 

 Halfback
 
 
 
• It often take free hits inside the opposite half.
 
• It support attacks on the wings by providing sharp crosses. 
 
 
 
 

 Pushin
 
 
 
• A push pass is used to move the ball speedily over shorter distances.
